description: Two stepped random voltage sources, each picking a new value between two limits every time it is triggered, with a slew on the way there

params.text: Sets the upper limit of that channel's random range, -5V to 5V
Sets the lower limit of that channel's random range, -5V to 5V; set above the upper limit it freezes the channel at the upper value
Slews that channel's steps, the slowest glide at the far right; the very bottom of the travel passes the steps through unslewed

inputs.text: A gate above 0.5V makes the first channel pick a new value
Adds to that channel's upper limit, one volt for one volt
Adds to that channel's lower limit, one volt for one volt
A gate above 0.5V makes the second channel pick a new value; with nothing patched here the second channel steps whenever the first one does

outputs.text: That channel's random voltage, clamped to ±5V
